focus-ring-inverse.$description: Focus-visible ring color for actions on the inverse surface, such as the Arizona Header — aliases the brand palette.

inverse.$description: Dark surface that light text sits on, such as the Arizona Header — aliases the brand palette.

brand.$description: Bold brand-red surface that light text sits on: the original red Arizona Header, which Arizona Bootstrap plans to deprecate (az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299) — aliases the brand palette.

inverse.$description: Text and icon color on the inverse surface — aliases the brand palette.

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

color.$description: Header fill (Blue), the default since Arizona Bootstrap 5.2. Per az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299.
The original red header's fill, which replaces container.color. Arizona Bootstrap plans to deprecate the red header; don't use it for new sites. Per az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299.
Keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons, drawn inside the element's edge. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

width.$description: Width of the inset keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

color.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) text and icon color. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

min-width.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) minimum width. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

min-height.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) minimum height: the header's own height. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

scroll-offset.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): how far below the top of the screen linked sections stop when scrolled to, so the header doesn't cover them. Per Arizona Bootstrap.
